name: clay
label: Clay
description: Search Clay's GTM database, and move table rows in and out of Clay.

token.label: API Key
token.description: Create a key from [Settings > Account > API keys (beta)](https://app.clay.com/workspaces/~/settings/account?accountTab=api-keys-beta), then paste it here.

search_companies.label: Search Companies
search_companies.description: Searches Clay's company database using structured filters.

company_identifiers.label: Company Identifiers
company_identifiers.description: Domains or LinkedIn company URLs to match exactly, e.g. "stripe.com".

headquarters_only.label: Match headquarters location only
headquarters_only.description: Only match the office marked as the company headquarters, not any office.

keyword.label: Description Keyword
keyword.description: Matches companies whose description contains this word or phrase.

advanced_filter.label: Advanced Filter (Clay query syntax)
advanced_filter.description: Optional raw filter, ANDed onto the filters above. See Clay's advanced search query syntax: https://developers.clay.com/searches/advanced

body.query: select from companies where description contains "{{keyword}}" and ({{advanced_filter}})

search_people.label: Search People
search_people.description: Searches Clay's people database using structured filters.

job_titles.label: Job Title
job_titles.description: Matches similar titles too (e.g. "VP of Sales" also matches "Head of Sales").

company_identifiers.label: Employer (Domains or LinkedIn URLs)
company_identifiers.description: Matches people at these exact companies. Scoped by Employment Tenure above.

company_name_contains.label: Employer Name Contains
company_name_contains.description: Fuzzy employer name match, use when you don't have a domain. Scoped by Employment Tenure above.

options.label: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands

advanced_filter.label: Advanced Filter (Clay query syntax)
advanced_filter.description: Optional raw filter, ANDed onto the filters above. See Clay's advanced search query syntax: https://developers.clay.com/searches/advanced

body.query: select from people where full_name contains "{{full_name_contains}}" and headline contains "{{headline_contains}}" and about contains "{{about_contains}}" and experiences.any(is_current = true and company_name contains "{{company_name_contains}}") and ({{advanced_filter}})
